features: Dual-Mode Connectivity Effortlessly switch between a 2.4 GHz USB-C nano receiver and Bluetooth 5.0. Pair up to three Bluetooth devices (BT1, BT2, BT3) or your computer via 2.4 GHz at the flip of a switch for ultimate multitasking.
Ultra-Slim 100-Key Keyboard Low-profile scissor-switch keys deliver a quiet, responsive typing experience—perfect for work, gaming, or study in any setting.
Precision Wireless Mouse Ergonomically contoured and equipped with a 1000 DPI optical sensor for smooth, accurate cursor control on virtually any surface.
Built-in Rechargeable Power Both keyboard and mouse house 500 mAh Li-ion batteries. Enjoy days of uninterrupted use on a single charge, and recharge quickly via USB-C.

Broad OS & Multi-Device Support Plug-and-play compatibility with Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS. Seamless device switching keeps your workflow—and your playlist—in sync across laptop, tablet, and smartphone.
description: Experience desktop-style productivity anywhere with the Frontech FT-1602A Wireless Keyboard & Mouse Combo. Engineered for versatility, this slim 100-key keyboard and precision 1000 DPI mouse give you full command of every task—whether you’re editing documents, gaming, or streaming media. Switch between three Bluetooth-paired devices and a 2.4 GHz USB connection at the press of a button, and stay unplugged for days thanks to built-in 500 mAh rechargeable batteries. Finished in sleek white and designed to complement any setup, the FT-1602A is your all-in-one solution for work and play.
